delta_verdicts.reasoning: raw=$(timeout --foreground N pgrep -s SID); rc=$? captures the substitution's own status (timeout's, i.e. pgrep's 0/1 or 124/125/128+sig) in the same shell; no pipe, so no tr status can mask it. rc 0 requires nonempty output for MEMBERS, otherwise UNKNOWN:0-empty; rc 1 EMPTY; other UNKNOWN:<rc>. Newline->space is done in-process (${raw//$'\n'/ }); consumers use word-splitting/.split() so the lost trailing space is irrelevant. Callers unchanged: launcher wait_session_empty true only on EMPTY, quarantine on non-EMPTY; driver session_state reaps only on MEMBERS, finish 99 on any UNKNOWN. Both V6 counterexamples (clean control -> MEMBERS '' -> quarantine 5; scan timeout -> MEMBERS '' tested as absence of leftovers) are closed at source.
